# Contract: bisect-anything

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: engineering. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Reliable pass/fail oracles, commit or version regression search in a separate worktree, hunk minimisation and a causal explanation.

## Use it for
- "what commit broke this"
- "it used to work"

## Not for
- a flaky test with no regression point (flaky-test-killer)

## Accepted inputs
A repo, a good and a bad point, an oracle command.

## Deliverables
The first bad commit (or an honest inconclusive list), minimal hunk, explanation.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- Git

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Build time per step.

## Workflow
1. Pin down the regression
2. Write the oracle
3. Run it
4. Explain the commit

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- What counts as the regression (oracle scope)

## Quality checks
- Oracle proven good and bad on both ends
- selftest.py planted scenarios

## Common failures
- Flaky oracle (use repeats)
- Unbuildable commits (skip, reported)

## Limitations
- Windows process-tree kill uses taskkill; not yet run on native Windows

## Reproducible example
examples/selftest.py: 40-commit repo with planted bug, slowdown, visual change and unbuildable commits.

## Validation status
**functionally verified** (2026-11-13, Linux 6.18.44-fc-v445 (x86_64), Python 3.13.18). selftest: all planted scenarios found the right commit (14.8 s)
